motivationObligation.motivation: Whether survivalist self-interest bends toward preserving the massacre evidence and treating witnesses as people rather than tools; now also whether she'll help kill a decent man on Vorn's order

talents.name: Smooth Talker (Deception)
talents.description: When making Deception checks, spend Triumph to gain additional Successes equal to ranks.

talents.name: Hidden Storage
talents.description: Gain hidden storage in vehicles or equipment with total encumbrance equal to ranks.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.description: Once per round, draw or holster an easily accessible weapon/item as an incidental; reduces Prepare rating by 1 to minimum 1.

talents.name: Deep Pockets
talents.description: Once per session, produce a small narratively useful item from pockets/bag; generally under 100 credits and encumbrance 0–1, subject to GM approval.

talents.name: Stalker
talents.description: Add Boost per rank to Stealth and Coordination checks.

inventory.name: Cover-appropriate gear only
inventory.note: personal effects not itemized for Mission 02 — Vorn's team controls the loadout; three drinks in as part of the current cantina scene

motivationObligation.motivation: Whether he remains a soldier making hard choices or becomes the weapon Vorn wants; served with Colonel Rennick before his fall — an unresolved recognition thread

talents.name: Toughened
talents.description: Increase wound threshold by 2 per rank.

talents.name: Grit
talents.description: Increase strain threshold by 1 per rank.

talents.name: Quick Strike
talents.description: Add Boost per rank to combat checks against targets that have not acted this encounter.

talents.name: Challenge!
talents.description: Once per encounter, choose adversaries within short range up to ranks in Challenge!; until encounter ends/incapacitation, those adversaries add Setback when targeting Kenno and an additional Setback when targeting others.

talents.name: Rapid Recovery
talents.description: Heal 1 additional strain per rank when healing strain after an encounter.

talents.name: Painful Blow
talents.description: May increase combat check difficulty by one; if the target suffers wounds, it suffers 2 strain each time it performs a maneuver until encounter end.

talents.name: Desperate Recovery
talents.description: Before healing strain after an encounter, if current strain is more than half threshold, heal 2 additional strain.

talents.name: Physical Training
talents.description: Add Boost per rank to Athletics and Resilience checks.

inventory.name: Cover-appropriate gear only
inventory.note: personal effects not itemized for Mission 02 — Vorn's team controls the loadout

motivationObligation.motivation: Whether he treats the evidence as leverage, truth, mission liability, or the path to freeing the group from Cresh Spike collar control

talents.name: Hand on the Throttle
talents.description: Once per round while driving/piloting a vehicle, may increase or decrease vehicle speed by 1 within normal limits.

talents.name: Signature Vehicle
talents.description: Chosen vehicle: Z-95 Headhunter 'Sure Thing.' Upgrades Mechanics checks once when working on it.

talents.name: Smooth Talker
talents.description: Choose Charm, Coercion, Deception, or Negotiation before first use. Spend Triumph on checks with that skill to gain additional Successes equal to ranks.

talents.name: Shortcut
talents.description: During a chase, add Boost per rank to checks made to catch or escape an opponent.

talents.name: Unstoppable
talents.description: If a Critical Injury roll is 1 or reduced to 1, do not receive the critical injury.

talents.name: Trust the Captain
talents.description: Make a Hard Leadership check. If successful, for the rest of the encounter allies within short range increase their ranks in Discipline by an amount equal to ranks in Trust the Captain.
